warrant: The observable follows both kinetic species and the electrostatic field through shock formation; vte (line 79) sets vti, the sound speed, the velocity-space extent and the initial Maxwellians. A wrong species mass or charge, velocity-space flux, boundary update, moment reduction or Poisson coupling changes these histories; the mechanisms are under vlasov/zero/ and vlasov/apps/. The bound atol=rtol=1e-11, confirmed at review on 2026-09-04, is combined with the value: the two-ULP spread of 7.64e-11 and the strict-IEEE altbuild (same source, gcc -O2, no -ffast-math, -ffp-contract=off, no -march=native) difference of 1.02e-10 both sit on the ion L2 history at values of order 6e3, where the combined bound is about 6.2e-8, 600 times the larger floor; on the near-zero moment samples the absolute term governs and the largest measured error there is 4.1e-14, 240 times under it.
